versions.name: RXV2-0.9.260-gap-position
versions.notes: The longest gap now says WHEN it struck ('55.1 ms at 00:00:12') so you can tell a connect-ritual tail from a mid-flight dropout at a glance. Also: the transmitter switch-off pause is now scrubbed permanently (turning the TX back on quickly can no longer resurrect it into the stats). Includes the 3-second handshake grace from 0.9.259. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.259-grace-3s
versions.notes: Link statistics now start when the connection is 3 seconds old (was 2 - a 55 ms handshake straggler remained), and the radio-swap count and per-radio times are re-baselined at the same moment, so the transmitter's connect ritual no longer inflates any flight figure. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.258-handshake-grace
versions.notes: THE 1-SECOND GAP, SOLVED FOR REAL: it was the V1 transmitter's own connect ritual - bind confirm and model-ID handshake pause its radio for about a second before the green light. The V1 transmitter has always hidden this by wiping its stats just after the green light; the receiver now applies the same wisdom - gap statistics only start once the connection is 2 seconds old. Also: a flight's R1/R2 radio times now stop at the last packet (no more growing on the bench). Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.257-ble-preheat
versions.notes: KILLS the mystery 1-second gap (finally - the black box breadcrumbs caught it): the Bluetooth radio's very first transmission does a one-off calibration that deafens the receiver chips for about a second. It used to fire mid-session when the transmitter was on from power-up; Bluetooth now starts at boot, before any link exists, so the deaf moment happens before the first packet. Also: a flight's per-radio times now stop counting at the last packet, so R1+R2 matches the flight duration. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.256-gap-hunt
versions.notes: Hunts the mystery 1-second link gap seen when the transmitter is on from power-up: a flash write fired at exactly t=5s used to freeze the processor mid-session - it now waits for a link-quiet moment. Also, any large gap on a live link is recorded in the event log with a timestamp, so the black box itself explains any future gap. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.255-save-label
versions.notes: The save button on the Output protocol page now tells the truth: it says 'Save' normally and only grows into 'Save & reboot' when you have actually selected a different protocol. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.254-armed-no-wave
versions.notes: Safety: the Bluetooth-ready wave is suppressed while the model is ARMED with a live transmitter link, so an in-flight brownout reboot can never wiggle the controls mid-air. Bench reboots with the transmitter on (disarmed) still wave. Includes 0.9.253's civilised save flow: instant-apply saves stay on the page; the reboot-wait screen only appears for a real protocol change. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.253-save-flow
versions.notes: Saving settings is now civilised: a save that applies instantly (wave channels, throttle/arming channel, CRSF rate, FC-telemetry) says 'Saved - applied instantly' and stays on the page; the reboot-wait screen only appears for a genuine protocol change, and over Bluetooth it waits for the app's automatic reconnection. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.252-wave-visible
versions.notes: Second-aileron wave now VISIBLE: a channel parked outside servo range (AUX channels rest at 500us before the TX is heard) waves around CENTRE instead of hugging its end-stop, where the movement was real in the data but invisible on the surface. Adds a Test-wave button next to the wave-channels setting, and saving settings from the phone app no longer risks a dead black page. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.251-wave-api
versions.notes: Adds POST /api/wave: fire the Bluetooth-ready wave on demand (refused while the transmitter link is live). Bench-test hook and 'which model is this?' finder. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.250-wave-polish
versions.notes: Wave fix: channels that sit at a low value (e.g. a second aileron on ch6, which boots at 500us) now get the FULL wave - previously the wiggle was clipped flat at the servo floor, so only channel 1 appeared to move. Every waved channel also returns EXACTLY to where it started when the wave ends (they were being left at the last wave position). The arming channel is never waved. Installing this also updates the web pages.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.249-wave-channels
versions.notes: The Bluetooth-ready wave is now configurable and universal: choose WHICH channels wave on the Output protocol page (e.g. 1,6 for a plane with two aileron servos; the throttle channel never waves), and the wave now fires EVERY time Bluetooth becomes available - power-on included - not just after switching the transmitter off. Also works on models with no captured failsafe. Installing this also updates the web pages.
